key_insight: X-AVDD distills paired audio-visual data by using cross-attention to preserve inter-modal semantics, making synthetic datasets more aligned and much more memory-efficient than prior methods.
engineering_relevance: This enables scalable audio-visual dataset distillation for larger models and higher samples-per-class settings, reducing synthesis cost while retaining strong downstream training utility.
method: Use cross-attention to explicitly model audio-visual correspondence during synthesis.
Decouple cross-modal alignment from joint optimization to reduce memory usage.
Generate compact synthetic paired data that preserves cross-modal semantics for training.
evidence_signal: On VGGSound, X-AVDD raises top-1 accuracy from 8.2% to 24.0% at SPC=10 and from 9.8% to 26.5% at SPC=20, and it also improves cross-architecture transfer and scales to AudioCLIP with much lower training time.
watch_item: Performance depends on carefully maintaining cross-modal alignment during synthesis, so mismatched audio-visual pairing or unstable attention learning could reduce distillation quality.
